description.zh: 这是澳大利亚乡间的一段林间弯道，两侧有围栏、植被和袋鼠警示牌。你可以步行探索，靠近标牌并改变观察角度；此区域没有 E 键交互。
description.en: An Australian bush road bend with fences, vegetation and wildlife signs. Explore on foot, approach the signs and change your viewpoint; this area has no E-key interactions.

description.zh: 这是一段澳大利亚乡间直路，路侧有标牌、树木、倒木和围栏。你可以沿路行走、接近路边物体或离开后返回观察；此区域没有 E 键交互。
description.en: A straight Australian country road with signs, trees, fallen logs and fences. Walk along the road, approach roadside objects, or leave and return to inspect them; there are no E-key interactions.

description.zh: 这是一处澳大利亚溪谷林地，包含岩石、倒木、树木和溪水。你可以在小范围内步行探索，从不同距离和角度观察物体；此区域没有 E 键交互。
description.en: An Australian creek canyon with rocks, fallen logs, trees and water. Explore the small area on foot and inspect objects from different distances and angles; there are no E-key interactions.
